messages.author: Saoirse Lindgren
messages.text: INC-70870 was reclassified by PRB-4118 — not charged. The March 18 pool exhaustion rolls out of the 30-day window on the 17th.

messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: Weekday sessions on the payments lane are embargoed. Anyone wanting tonight is asking Tunde, not me. Dario is on secondary tonight and tomorrow night without the payments runbook cert.

messages.author: Tunde Abara
messages.text: The settlement cutover freeze holds the payments lane Friday and Saturday. Sunday night is open and nobody has asked me for an exception.
